evidence.excerpt: PERMTEMP aimed to produce a systematically collected reference dataset of temperature-dependent oxygen, carbon dioxide and water vapour permeability for ten commercially relevant polyolefin film grades, covering the range 5–50 °C. Arrhenius activation energies and pre-exponential factors were determined by least-squares regression on multi-temperature OTR and WVTR datasets. The dataset was made available to Serbian food-industry companies through a technical report and an online spreadsheet tool for shelf-life estimation. The project also calibrated the Faculty of Technology permeability laboratory instruments against certified reference films, establishing a documented calibration protocol that remains in use.
